name: shared_buffers
description: Sets the number of 8kB shared memory buffers used by the PostgreSQL server for caching data pages.
symptoms: High disk I/O due to cache misses
OOM error when set too high on memory-constrained systems
Poor query performance under concurrent load
Shared memory allocation failure (ENOMEM) on startup
tuning_tips: Set to 25–40% of total RAM on dedicated servers; reduce proportionally for shared or low-memory systems. Always benchmark, and ensure OS shared memory limits (shmmax/shmall) are configured accordingly.
